prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game furnishing sprite atlas for Lantern Commons. Create one wide 3 by 2 evenly spaced atlas, six fully isolated objects each wholly within its cell with generous transparent padding. Soft hand-painted storybook cozy woodland village, warm walnut wood, moss green accents, golden amber lantern light, gentle elevated frontal camera (not isometric), coherent detailed silhouettes readable at small scale. Top row left to right: a freestanding roofed wooden quest notice board with blank cream paper notices; a tall wooden bookshelf of jewel toned books with small brass lantern; a small writing desk with open cream diary and quill. Bottom row: a tidy stack of blue ceramic water jars in a wooden rack; burlap food sacks and sealed wooden provisions crates; an equipment chest with neatly rolled blankets and a shield. No people, no floor, no room, no background, no lettering, no symbols resembling UI, no cropped edges, no touching objects between cells. All six sprites grounded along the same relative baseline in each cell. Truly transparent background.
selection: First generated atlas; alpha preserved in WebP conversion. Six non-overlapping source windows are in CommonsWorld.art.furnishings. Used in world interiors, quest board and private panels. The second extraction experiment was not shipped.
